Mi nombre es Juan José Venegas y soy pas: My name is Juan José Venegas, and I am a pastor in Costa Rica.
Durante muchos años, una parte important: For many years, an important part of my ministry has been preparing Bible studies, teaching the Word of God and looking for tools that would let me go ever deeper into the Scriptures. Like many other pastors and leaders in Latin America, I soon discovered a reality that thousands of people probably know well: the desire to study was there, but the resources were not always within reach.
A lo largo de los años utilicé diferente: Over the years I used various Bible study programs such as MySword, theWord, e-Sword and other excellent tools that have been a great blessing to millions of believers. Thanks to them I grew a great deal in my training. However, I also faced the same limits many Latin American ministers face: commentaries, dictionaries, Bibles and other specialized modules that, because of licensing or cost, were out of my reach.
No se trataba únicamente del precio de u: It was not only the price of an app. Often the real obstacle was the gap between those costs and the economic reality of those of us who serve in Latin America. For many pastors, students and leaders, buying a complete digital library is simply not possible.
Con el paso del tiempo comprendí que no: Over time I understood that this was not my difficulty alone. I heard the same story from believers in different countries and saw how many ended up settling for whatever free resources they found, not because they were enough, but because that was all they could get.
Hoy la tecnología nos permite hacer cosa: Today technology lets us do things that seemed impossible a few years ago. The internet, mobile devices and new development tools have opened extraordinary opportunities to put knowledge within anyone's reach.
That is how Verbo was born.
Verbo no pretende reemplazar el excelent: Verbo does not intend to replace the excellent work done by other Bible study platforms. On the contrary, it recognizes the enormous contribution many of them have made for years. Its purpose is to meet a very specific need: to offer the Spanish-speaking church a modern, easy-to-use and ever more complete platform, where access to quality resources does not depend on each person's purchasing power.
Nuestro compromiso es seguir incorporand: Our commitment is to keep adding new Bibles, commentaries, dictionaries, timelines, maps, study tools and other aids that strengthen the ministry of pastors, teachers, leaders and students of the Word of God.
Sabemos que el camino por recorrer es la: We know the road ahead is long, and that every new resource, every improvement and every update brings us a little closer to what we dream of building.
Confiamos en que Dios seguirá guiando es: We trust that God will keep guiding this project and allowing it to be a blessing to His church.
Si Verbo logra ayudar a un pastor a prep: If Verbo manages to help a pastor prepare a better sermon, a teacher understand the Scriptures better or a believer go deeper into the Word of God, then all the effort will have been worth it.
Ese ha sido el propósito desde el primer: That has been the purpose from the first day, and it is still the same.
